fusions.name: Clamp and Roll
fusions.desc: A clamping, rolling weapon strike that deals 24 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 30% for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Jaws From Below
fusions.desc: Snaps a hinged jaw shut across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Mantrap in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Sets a jaw trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage.

fusions.name: Grip Never Slackens
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
